summary: WeRide Inc. filed a Form 6-K attaching a Next Day Disclosure Return for Hong Kong listing rules. The filing reports an open-market share repurchase on April 29, 2026, of 720,000 ordinary shares at USD 2.4917 per share, representing 0.0757% of existing issued shares. The repurchased shares are held as treasury shares. The board confirms compliance with listing rules. This is a routine share buyback disclosure for a dual-listed company; no premium, tender, or special event. The transaction is a small capital return via open-market purchases.
